entities.name: Bjørn Aage Ibsen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bjørn Aage Ibsen was a Danish anaesthetist and founder of intensive-care medicine. He also invented one of the first functional positive pressure ventilators, which saved many lives during the poliomyelitis epidemic in Denmark 1952-1953.
